newsitem.title: GERMANY: Berlin's Brandenburg gate passes wobble test.
newsitem.headline: Berlin's Brandenburg gate passes wobble test.

text.p: Berlin's Brandenburg Gate, symbol of German unity, was given a clean bill of health on Friday after media reports that construction work on Germany's future government quarter had shaken its foundations.

A complex of government buildings and a huge tunnel are being built near the 18th century arch, which had stood alone amid the fortifications of the Berlin Wall for 25 years. Media reports said the gate showed signs of movement.
But a spokeswoman for the city government, citing a survey carried out by the Berlin building department, said there was no sign of any cracking.
"There is no danger of it falling down," she said.
